## 2. Core Capabilities & Services

### Custom Web Application Development
- **URL**: https://maxoratechnology.com/Services/web-development
- **Technologies**: Next.js (App Router), React, TypeScript, Node.js, Tailwind CSS, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Redis
- **Scope**:
  - High-performance web applications built from scratch or Figma specifications.
  - Sub-2-second initial page loads with 90+ Google Core Web Vitals performance.
  - Full-stack database architecture, secure authentication, API integration, and automated CI/CD deployments.
  - Zero bloated plugins or vendor lock-in; clean modular codebases.

### Mobile Application Development
- **URL**: https://maxoratechnology.com/Services/app-development
- **Technologies**: Flutter, React Native, Swift (iOS), Kotlin (Android), Firebase, REST/GraphQL APIs
- **Scope**:
  - Cross-platform unified mobile applications for iOS and Android.
  - Offline-first SQLite/IndexedDB caching, background sync, and push notification infrastructure.
  - Biometric security integration (Face ID / Touch ID).
  - App Store & Google Play compliance, submission, and release management.

### Custom CRM & ERP Business Systems
- **URL**: https://maxoratechnology.com/Services/crm-erp
- **Technologies**: Next.js, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, Webhooks
- **Scope**:
  - Purpose-built internal management software replacing disconnected spreadsheets and expensive SaaS per-seat licenses.
  - Visual Kanban deal pipelines, custom lead intake forms, and automated WhatsApp notification routing.
  - Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), multi-tenant data isolation, and comprehensive audit logs.
  - Zero recurring seat licenses — clients own their infrastructure outright.

### E-Commerce Platforms & Headless Storefronts
- **URL**: https://maxoratechnology.com/Services/ecommerce
- **Technologies**: Next.js Commerce, Shopify API, WooCommerce, Razorpay, Stripe, UPI
- **Scope**:
  - Blazing-fast headless e-commerce storefronts engineered for conversion rate optimization.
  - Seamless localized checkout with Indian UPI payment gateways and international currency support.
  - Automated abandoned-cart triggers, instant predictive search filtering, and inventory sync.

### WordPress Engineering & Performance Optimization
- **URL**: https://maxoratechnology.com/Services/wordpress
- **Technologies**: PHP, WordPress Core, Custom Gutenberg Blocks, MySQL
- **Scope**:
  - Custom block themes built without bulky visual page builders (no Elementor/Divi bloat).
  - High-security configuration, database query optimization, and Core Web Vitals remediation.

### Technical SEO & AI Answer Engine Optimization (AEO/GEO)
- **URL**: https://maxoratechnology.com/Services/seo-aeo
- **Technologies**: Schema.org JSON-LD, Core Web Vitals Engineering, llms.txt, Machine-Readable Metadata
- **Scope**:
  - Formatting content into clear, extractable answer blocks and structured schemas optimized for Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Claude, and Gemini citations.
  - Comprehensive entity graph implementation using JSON-LD (Organization, Service, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList).
  - Authoring and maintaining `llms.txt`, `llms-full.txt`, and `pricing.md` for autonomous AI buying agents.
  - Technical speed audits ensuring Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) under 2.5 seconds and Interaction to Next Paint (INP) under 200ms.

### AI & Automation Services
- **URL**: https://maxoratechnology.com/Services/ai-automation
- **Technologies**: OpenAI, Claude, Vapi, Retell AI, ElevenLabs, Twilio Voice, WhatsApp Business Cloud API, n8n, Make, LangChain, PostgreSQL/pgvector
- **Scope**:
  - Conversational AI Voice Assistants: Inbound call answering, caller qualification, Google/Calendly booking, and live agent call forwarding with sub-500ms latency.
  - WhatsApp AI Support Bots: Official Meta Cloud API integration with RAG retrieval from company documents/catalogs, multi-language support, and human escalation.
  - Autonomous Lead Pipelines: Sub-60-second lead qualification and enrichment from Meta Ads, Google Ads, and web forms directly into CRM with automated WhatsApp/SMS sequences.
  - Document Extraction Agents: Automated data extraction from invoices, receipts, PDFs, and emails into ERP/databases without manual data entry.

## 3. Free AI Visibility Audit

- **URL**: https://maxoratechnology.com/ai-visibility-check
- **Description**: A free diagnostic service for businesses to discover whether ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews cite their brand over competitors for high-intent search queries.
- **Deliverables**: Detailed report showing citation frequency, schema validation gaps, and actionable recommendations.

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

### What makes Maxora Technology different from standard software agencies?
We operate with an engineering-first model. Clients communicate directly with the engineers writing their code. Every solution is built with 100% intellectual property ownership, zero vendor lock-in, and zero monthly per-seat licensing fees.

### How are software projects priced?
Every project is custom-scoped based on your exact business requirements, technical complexity, and agreed milestone deliverables. We provide transparent, milestone-driven estimates after an initial technical discovery with zero recurring seat fees.

### How quickly does the team respond to new inquiries?
Our engineering team reviews project details directly and replies via WhatsApp or email within a few hours (guaranteed within 24 hours).
